sources.title: QMCPACK statistics laboratory
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: GADGET-4：加速度步長界與二進位時間階層
related.titleEn: GADGET-4: acceleration timestep bounds and binary time hierarchy
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：報告包含樣本窗、g、區塊證據與系統誤差限制，不只平均數。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: The report includes the sample window, g, blocking evidence and systematic limitations, not just a mean.
related.difference: 使用原創合成資料研究「GADGET-4：加速度步長界與二進位時間階層」，從物理或資料契約推導計算，並以反例驗證。完成：交付量綱推導、連續界與排程值對照、向上取整反例與守恆測試計畫。
related.differenceEn: Investigate GADGET-4: acceleration timestep bounds and binary time hierarchy using an original synthetic fixture. Derive the calculation from its physical or data contract, challenge it with a counterexample, and defend a bounded conclusion. Complete: Deliver dimensional derivation, continuous-versus-scheduled timestep tables, an upward-rounding counterexample and a conservation-test plan that records the assumptions excluded from the simplified criterion.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 算 g=4 時 Neff=100，再以兩種等價公式得標準誤；與錯誤獨立假設 g=1 的結果比較。
計算基線界約 0.0158114，再平方回推；使用同一公式但不同算序作獨立核算。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: For g=4 calculate Neff=100 and obtain the standard error using both equivalent formulas. Compare with the deliberately incorrect independent-sample assumption g=1, explaining why identical raw sample counts can support different uncertainty estimates.

Calculate the baseline bound near 0.0158114 and square it to recover the underlying ratio. Repeat the arithmetic in a different order, retaining intermediate units, to detect misplaced factors of two or an accidental squared softening length.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: MFEM：Gauss 積分精確度與有限元素混疊
related.titleEn: MFEM: Gauss quadrature exactness and finite-element aliasing
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：報告包含樣本窗、g、區塊證據與系統誤差限制，不只平均數。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: The report includes the sample window, g, blocking evidence and systematic limitations, not just a mean.
related.difference: 使用原創合成資料研究「MFEM：Gauss 積分精確度與有限元素混疊」，從物理或資料契約推導計算，並以反例驗證。完成：交付節點權重表、解析與離散積分、混疊反例及幾何映射檢查。
related.differenceEn: Investigate MFEM: Gauss quadrature exactness and finite-element aliasing using an original synthetic fixture. Derive the calculation from its physical or data contract, challenge it with a counterexample, and defend a bounded conclusion. Complete: Deliver node-weight tables, analytic and discrete integrals, an aliasing counterexample and a geometry-mapping checklist tied to the actual finite-element integrand.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 算 g=4 時 Neff=100，再以兩種等價公式得標準誤；與錯誤獨立假設 g=1 的結果比較。
分別計兩個節點的四次方與權重，說明規則只保證至三次，因此失敗不是浮點微小誤差。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: For g=4 calculate Neff=100 and obtain the standard error using both equivalent formulas. Compare with the deliberately incorrect independent-sample assumption g=1, explaining why identical raw sample counts can support different uncertainty estimates.

Evaluate the fourth power at both nodes and apply their weights. Explain that the rule guarantees only degree-three exactness, so the observed discrepancy is a structural underintegration error rather than a tiny floating-point artifact.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
